## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`

- names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Every one of the six is read by `normalizeSeries` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts:242-255`) and does real work in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — `label` names the legend entry, `variant === 'comparison'` selects the muted overlay, `opacity` / `dashArray` set stroke and fill, `stack` becomes Recharts' `stackId`, `yAxis` binds the secondary axis. Any consumer of the parse output — `objectui check` / `objectui validate` via `safeValidateSchema`, a JSON schema derived from the mirror, or any pipeline that keeps `parse()`'s result — lost them outright.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `8c10f4f71` (merge-base with origin/main): 3 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1331 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1904 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36050944373)

### ① Derived judgments

- (a) Accept-set is exactly the ruling's. `hasNoPlottableSeries` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`) returns null unless `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES.has(chartType) && rows.length > 0`, then `'undeclared'` for `series === undefined`, `'empty'` for `Array.isArray(series) && series.length === 0`, else null. `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES` is unchanged from main at 1f8ef0a89: `bar`, `horizontal-bar`, `line`, `area`, `combo`. `column` is not a set member on main or at head; it reaches the set through the pre-existing `props.chartType === 'column' ? 'bar'` normalization, which the diff does not touch. The predicate is called in the outer `AdvancedChartImpl` wrapper on raw props, and `AdvancedChartImplInner` (`series = []` default parameter at its signature) is only reached by the wrapper's final `return <AdvancedChartImplInner {...props} />`, so the distinction is taken before the default erases it. pie / donut / funnel / radar / scatter / treemap / sankey all read `series[0]?.dataKey || 'value'` in the inner component and are outside the set; the new test loop pins pie, donut, funnel, radar and scatter drawing an svg with no refusal and no warning. Zero rows returns null before either arm (pinned).
- (a, order) `missingCategoryKey ? null : hasNoPlottableSeries(props)` keeps the `missing-category-key` refusal winning, as before.
- (b) No drawable surface regresses. `ChartRenderer.tsx` is the only importer of `AdvancedChartImpl` (`React.lazy(() => import('./AdvancedChartImpl'))`; repo-wide grep at head confirms). It forwards `spec.series ?? authored`, where `normalizeChartSchema` derives `series` from `schema.series`, else `schema.categories`, else the y-axis `field`s; `undefined` survives only when none of the three yields an entry. Every producer feeding `ChartRenderer` measured: `DashboardRenderer.tsx` and `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` always build `series: [{ dataKey: yField }]`; `DatasetWidget.tsx` and `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` pass `buildChartSeries` output (always an array); `ObjectView.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` always pass an array (`vals.map` or `[{ dataKey: valueField }]`); `DatasetPreview.tsx` maps `measureNames`; `ObjectChart.tsx` forwards `datasetChart.series` or `augmentedSeries` or the author's own `schema.series`. Inside `AdvancedChartImplInner` the bar / horizontal-bar / line / area tail and the combo `ComposedChart` tail emit marks only from `series.map(...)`; the only series-independent children are `annotationEls`, `brushEl`, axes, grid, tooltip and legend. No path derives a series from `yAxisKey`, `value` or categories for these families, so the dev's claim holds: every cartesian chart that reached the inner component with `series === undefined` drew zero marks. The two schema-catalog chart entries (`advanced-line-chart.json`, `area-chart.json`) declare `series`. Falsification attempt failed.
- (c) One channel. Both arms render the same `ChartRefusal` component with `code="no-plottable-series"` and `role="status"`; no second placeholder component exists. Sentences: undeclared = "This chart cannot plot any series: none was declared to draw against its `X` axis."; empty = "This chart cannot plot any series: no measure or group reached its `X` axis." The rewritten pin asserts the two texts differ. The undeclared sentence is literally true for the shape that reaches it: `series === undefined` means the normalizer found no `series`, `categories` or y-axis field to declare one from. The console warning names the row keys and cites objectui#4695.
- (d) Pins. `AdvancedChartImpl.unprojectedSeriesDimension.test.tsx`: the `:205` pin is rewritten in place (title `refuses a caller that computed NO series binding at all, in its own sentence (objectui#4695)`), asserting placeholder, `role="status"`, no svg, one warning citing objectui#4695, and a differing sentence from the `series={[]}` control; a new `describe` covers the six-family loop (including `column`), the value-fallback families, the reverse control (2 `.recharts-rectangle`, no `data-chart-error`, no warning) and the no-rows case. Repo-wide sweep of test files for "plots nothing" / "zero marks" / "bars: 0" / "no series" / "empty frame" found no remaining pin asserting a series-only chart drawing with no series; the other hits are comments about pre-fix pictures or unrelated click payloads. `ChartRenderer.foreignDialectRetired-8650.test.tsx`: the two cases that asserted `{ bars: 0, lines: 0 }` on a bar with no series now `waitFor` the `no-plottable-series` refusal and assert no `.recharts-surface`; positive reading kept, since a re-added retired read would define a series, draw, and the `waitFor` would time out. The `plotted` / `marks` helpers remain used by three other cases, so nothing dangles. The edit is outside the claimed surface but is forced by the ruling's "leave no contradicting pin", is disclosed in the PR body and the dev report's deviations, and no open PR touches the file per the dev's read.
- (f) Truth. PR body and changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: the accept-set, the callers, the pins, the ablation, the single-code note and the "no i18n key" claim (`packages/i18n` untouched in the file list) are all consistent with what was measured. One PR-body sentence, "None of the 23 open PRs touches it", rests on the dev's read and was not re-derived here. Commit trailers on both commits are `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>`; a grep of both commit messages for model names returns nothing. Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Overwrite Report, Line Citation Gate, Build & E2E, Test (dist pins) are all success.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/4695-no-series-binding-refusal.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-charts': patch`. The repo's rule (AGENTS.md: patch for fixes, never `major`, objectui's own breaking changes as `minor`) and the direct precedent are consistent with patch: the objectui#4683 `no-plottable-series` refusal shipped under `### Patch Changes` in `packages/plugin-charts/CHANGELOG.md`, and `8269` (category-axis groupBy) is patch. The only minor in this family is `8650`, a key retirement, not a refusal. No type changed (`series?: NormalizedSeries[]` untouched), and the ruling frames the narrowing as a defect fix. Patch is correct; Changeset Bump Policy is green.

- Through `ChartRenderer` a literal authored `series: []` lands on the "computed and empty" sentence, and a malformed `categories: 'revenue'` lands on "none was declared" (the normalizer yields no series). Both are the pre-existing forwarding semantics, not introduced here, and both refuse rather than draw.
- A cartesian chart carrying only `annotations` (reference lines) and no series now refuses; it already refused with `series: []` since objectui#4683, so no new class of chart is blanked, but it is a shape the accept-set closes.
- `series: null` (excluded by the prop type) passes both arms and reaches the inner component's `series.map` unguarded; pre-existing, out of scope.
